verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is a SaaS document-processing platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its official docs describe a first-party hosted MCP endpoint (https://mcp.llamaindex.ai/mcp) that exposes Parse, Classify, Extract, Split, and Index as tools any MCP client can call. A separate documented docs-search MCP server offers search_docs, grep_docs, and read_doc, and a probe confirms the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully, and documented auth and client-configuration details for the endpoint.
